description: Generate spacing tokens from a base unit. Pass `base` (px, default 8) and one of: nothing (linear 4/8-point ladder: half step, 1x, 1.5x, 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 6x, 8x ...), `ratio` (modular: base times ratio to the power n, starting at the base), or `steps` (your own list of px values). `count` sets the token count (default 10, max 18 for linear and 24 for modular). Each token returns px, rem at 16px, a usage line (hairline gap, inside a component, component padding, between siblings, between groups, between sections), and a flag when the value is not a whole multiple of the base or is a fractional pixel. Also returns CSS custom properties in rem and in px, with an optional `prefix` (default space). Sources: Samara, Making and Breaking the Grid (consistent units); Graver and Jura, Best Practices for Graphic Designers (modular scales). The 4 or 8 point unit itself is a convention. Pure arithmetic, nothing stored.

ratio.description: Modular ratio, for example 1.5 or 1.25. Omit for a linear scale.

steps.description: Your own step list in px, for example [4, 8, 12, 16, 24, 40].
